verdict.rationale: Marqeta's homepage lists "PCI widgets" as a product feature. That is a first-party hosted-component capability plausibly aimed at displaying sensitive card data, but the pack contains only this one-line label with no documentation of how it works. missing for 10: documentation that the widgets reveal PAN/CVV to cardholders, any ephemeral-key or tokenized reveal flow, an explicit vendor statement that using them keeps the developer out of PCI SAQ D scope, integration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D
